_doc: Manual corrections for build_aliases.py. reject: variant slugs (or "variant>main") never to map. force: {variant: {main, reason, confidence, note}}.

retinyl.note: retinyl palmitate is an ester of retinol (vitamin A)

indometacin.note: INN and US (USAN) names of the same molecule

co-amoxiclav.note: co-amoxiclav is the British Approved Name for amoxicillin with clavulanic acid (pharmacology review batch 6, B6-03)

cephalexin.note: INN and US (USAN) names of the same molecule (pharmacology review batch 6, B6-26)
